name: What the app shows, as text
what: Everything the app shows can be read with the `silo` command, as plain text that a program can parse, and each view from the day it is built. On your Mac that is all of it. Inside a computer it is only what that computer may read. An agent can then answer "what did that run do" from the record and not by guessing.

suggest.why: An agent that reads the record answers "what did that run do" from what happened, not from a guess.
